verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say traces can be exported via the UI or API, which partly covers getting trace data out of the product. Nothing documents bulk export to blob storage or a data warehouse, or dataset export. The OpenTelemetry Collector fanout describes how an app routes traces on the way in, so it is not a LangSmith export feature. Missing for 10: documented bulk export to blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS), data warehouse destinations, dataset export, scheduled or large-volume export mechanics, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
